# Preview fixtures — stress matrix

One polished sample per preview kind. Used by `scripts/stress-preview-matrix.ps1`.

| File | Kind |
|------|------|
| `Brand_mark.svg` | SVG as picture (WebView2) |
| `Portrait_product.png` | Raster image |
| `swatch.bmp` | BMP |
| `main.py` / `demo_main.py` | Python (syntax highlight) |
| `utils.cpp` | C++ |
| `Program.cs` | C# |
| `app.ts` | TypeScript |
| `config.json` | JSON |
| `README.md` | Markdown |
| `page.html` | HTML |
| `Q3_Report.pdf` / `Contract_Lease.pdf` | PDF |

Add when available: `.mp4`, `.docx`, `.pptx`, `.xlsx`, `.webp`, `.heic`.
